EXP_ERP.name: FOB in the buyer’s currency = quantity × rate
every rupee value uses the one exchange rate
changing the rate moves every rupee figure together
the total export value is the sum of the shipments
there are exactly five documents per shipment
papers-complete means all five are ticked
the missing list is the papers not ticked
no shipment sailed with an incomplete set of papers
a shipment with a missing paper cannot be marked shipped
there are exactly two lawful routes
every shipment is on one of them
an LUT-bond shipment pays no IGST at all
a pay-and-claim shipment pays IGST at 5% of its rupee value
what the LUT bond saved = 5% of everything on it
a refund is only owed once the goods have shipped
refund owed counts only unrefunded, shipped claims
owed plus received = all the IGST ever paid out
recording a refund moves it from owed to received
every overdue claim really is past 60 days
an LUT shipment never appears in the refund list
every shipment sits in a real stage
waiting-to-be-paid counts only shipped and unsettled
a settled shipment is not waiting to be paid
country totals add up to the whole export value
every shipment counts once across the countries

POS_ERP.name: a line total = quantity × rate
the discount comes off before GST is worked out
GST is never charged on the discount
a bill total = taxable + GST
no bill carries a discount over 50%
every bill was paid in full
takings = every bill added up
the payment methods add up to the takings
average bill = takings ÷ number of bills
only cash is expected in the drawer
what should be in the drawer = float + cash taken
UPI, card and on-account are never expected in the drawer
over/short is nil until the drawer is counted
counting the exact expected amount reconciles to nil
counting less than expected shows short, not over
every counter line has a stock number
no counter line has gone negative
stock on hand = what was stocked less what was sold
the low-stock list is only items at or below their reorder point
an empty cart totals nothing
the cart cannot promise more than the counter holds
a cart discount over 50% is clamped, never applied
still-due and change-to-give are never both above zero
GST collected is the sum of the GST on every bill

every customer lands in exactly one segment

segment values add up to the total customer worth
